title: eriodictyon californicum
intro: Eriodictyon californicum, commonly known as California Yerba Santa, is a perennial shrub native to the southwestern United States and northwestern Mexico. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including its ability to calm the respiratory system and soothe coughs, making it a natural remedy for various respiratory issues. The health benefits of California Yerba Santa include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help reduce stress and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include eriodictyol, caffeic acid, and rosmarinic acid, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and bronchodilator.
